quest.title: Fate of a Fighter
quest.description: A taciturn wounded soldier is hiding inside a damaged boat on Nazuchi Beach — just another one of the thousand other tragedies that plague Yashiori Island, where the war has reached a temporary standstill...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Primogem x40, Hero's Wit x4, Mora x30000

dialogues.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
dialogues.text: Hmph, how humiliating...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! We saved your life! What do you mean we're "humiliating"?

response.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
response.text: To think that I had to be rescued by outlanders, and was even reduced to being judged by them...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh... So, Mr. Samurai, are you alright?

choices.text: Well, he seems alright, at least.

response.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
response.text: I am in your debt, outlander.

response.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
response.text: Also, you fought commendably.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: #I'm {NICKNAME}. Pleased to meet you.

response.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
response.text: Don't look down your nose at me, outlander.

response.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
response.text: ...Inaba Tousaburou Kyuuzou. Just call me Kyuuzou.

response.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
response.text: They're pirates. They have many strongholds around Nazuchi Beach.

response.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
response.text: Thugs, out-of-work miners and fishermen, fugitives running from the Vision Hunt Decree, deserters from both sides of the war... Sometimes, they gather into groups and degenerate into bandits and pirates. They try, in vain, to escape the control of Her Excellency.

response.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
response.text: Whether you call them Vagrants or Kairagi, they are all lawless thugs... We had been suppressing them for a while until the rebels destroyed the ward on the island...

response.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
response.text: The refugees from Tatarasuna and the mine fled in quick succession, and some of those rats scurried off to this place, swelling the ranks of these pirate gangs and making them more reckless.

response.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
response.text: That group of pirates just now came from the camp in the south, and they had their eyes on the cargo onboard.

response.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
response.text: Unfortunately for them, I ruined their plans... Hehe...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So this isn't your ship, then?

response.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
response.text: This thing? It belonged to the Sangonomiya rebels. I am not so sure myself... Either way, when I came, it was already deserted.

response.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
response.text: So I've stayed and lived in it like a hermit crab till now.

response.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
response.text: Hah, it's been a long time since I spoke so much. How exhausting...

response.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
response.text: If you do not mind, I will need your help with something. Once my wound has healed, I will surely return the favor I owe...

response.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
response.text: I need you to help me clear out the nearby pirate camp that I mentioned earlier.

response.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
response.text: That's the only way to stop them from coming back here and bothering me like a pack of stray dogs. It might even send the other pirate camps a message, so they don't get any ideas.

response.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
response.text: It'll also let me see what you can do. How about it?

response.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
response.text: Hmph. It seems you are fond of talking big...

response.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
response.text: By the way, outlander...

response.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
response.text: Don't get too conceited. Miss a step, and you might break your leg.

choices.text: Well, his pride is certainly hurt.
This is something unique to samurai...

dialogues.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
dialogues.text: You've returned.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, the atmosphere got weird all of a sudden...

response.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
response.text: I must apologize for asking you, an outsider, to do my dirty work.

choices.text: You're being a lot more polite than when we first met.

response.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
response.text: I've used up all the medicinal herbs I had.

response.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
response.text: I have run out of herbs to dress my wound, but it is still quite inflamed...

response.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
response.text: But please... You needn't worry about me. I can hold on.

response.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
response.text: Take care of your own business, go.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You're such a kid.

response.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
response.text: What did you say?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We're talking about you. You're acting like a child.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're clearly in a really bad way, and you look like you're about to cry for help, but still, you're acting like a tough guy... You're not honest at all!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Only kids do that.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And don't forget, Mr. Kyuuzou.

response.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
response.text: Hmph... you two...

response.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
response.text: In that case, please find some Naku weed for me. It can be found everywhere on this island. Full leaves are the best, the liquid can be squeezed out and applied to the wound to reduce inflammation...

response.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
response.text: That's all. I'm going to take a nap now, so leave me alone.

choices.text: You should have peace and quiet for a while.

talks.objective: Report the situation to Inaba Kyuuzou

dialogues.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
dialogues.text: You're back. Stay safe while you're on this island.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Will these be enough?

dialogues.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
dialogues.text: It will take a long time to mash the herbs into a paste. You can go now.

dialogues.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
dialogues.text: No, don't get me wrong. I'm not driving you away...

dialogues.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
dialogues.text: Come back after a while. It's good to have someone to chat with.

response.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
response.text: Take care, outlander.

talks.objective: Wait till 10:00 – 12:00 the next day and talk to Inaba Kyuuzou

dialogues.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
dialogues.text: Outlander, how have you been?

dialogues.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
dialogues.text: I apologize. This is no place for guests.

dialogues.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
dialogues.text: Still... I'm glad you could come.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You look much better now.

dialogues.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
dialogues.text: All thanks to you. Once again, I am in your debt.

dialogues.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
dialogues.text: Haha, isn't it a pity that I've survived yet again?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Isn't that a good thing? Why's that a pity?

response.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
response.text: I haven't made my mind up about what to do next, but I don't think I'll go back.

response.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
response.text: Kujou Masahito is not a bad person, but his old man is calling for deserters to be caught and punished...

response.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
response.text: I cannot afford to get on the wrong side of him.

response.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
response.text: Maybe I'll take off my armor. It's been nice, living alone here...

response.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
response.text: But until we have peace, there's no point deceiving myself. My memories assert that I am still that same wounded, bloodstained soldier...

response.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
response.text: *sigh* And who knows what might happen in the future?

response.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
response.text: Well, as I was saying, I had never doubted the decisions of Her Excellency, so I think that even if I died, I would die with no regrets, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, this conversation suddenly got heavy...

response.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
response.text: Ah, speaking of which, it's time for me to visit my old comrades in arms, who are still with me on this island.

response.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
response.text: In Inazuma's tradition, we offer our fallen comrades a Dendrobium, a delicate and noble flower... A symbol of the fate of all samurai.

response.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
response.text: By the way, if you meet my old comrades in arms in your journey, please stop for a moment and get to know them.

choices.text: Have you ever thought about going back?

talks.objective: Report the situation to Inaba Kyuuzou
Clear the nearby monster camps discarded

dialogues.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
dialogues.text: I'm tired. Please forgive my lack of hospitality.

dialogues.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
dialogues.text: ...And it seems that the rats nearby have begun scurrying about again.

dialogues.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
dialogues.text: Watch out for pirates if you wander around these parts, outlander.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
dialogues.text: You're welcome.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: They shall be no match for me.

dialogues.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
dialogues.text: Haha, again with the big talk...

dialogues.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
dialogues.text: Only say that once you've finally gotten rid of them all!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You have a deal.

dialogues.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
dialogues.text: Yes, that we do.

dialogues.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
dialogues.text: An outlander? Interesting...

dialogues.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
dialogues.text: If you're a tourist, you've come to the wrong place.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
dialogues.text: What, are you from the Shogunate?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No.

dialogues.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
dialogues.text: Then mind your own business.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This guy's so rude!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The Shogunate sent me, alright.

dialogues.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
dialogues.text: Why you outlanders...

dialogues.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
dialogues.text: In front of the Commissioner, you beg like dogs, but in front of us Inazuman samurai, you act all high and mighty...

dialogues.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
dialogues.text: Running here, spying there, stirring things up everywhere... And now you come all the way to this broken boat, for archons only know what.

dialogues.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
dialogues.text: Well, too bad. I'm just a wounded soldier. There's nothing I can do for you.

dialogues.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
dialogues.text: So if it pleases you, kindly get out of here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Doesn't this guy have any manners at all?

dialogues.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
dialogues.text: Whatever. You're too noisy.

dialogues.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
dialogues.text: Before you leave, let me give you a piece of advice: don't stay on Yashiori Island for too long. This island has been cursed.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Cursed?

dialogues.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
dialogues.text: What are you, deaf? I said that this island is cursed.

dialogues.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
dialogues.text: This never-ending stalemate, the ambitions of our lords, the despair of the common folk, the hatred welling up from the innocent victims, the charnel-sick of vulneraries filling the rooms of dying old people...

dialogues.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
dialogues.text: It's all a curse.

dialogues.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
dialogues.text: Leave before you get crushed under its weight.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon didn't get him at all. What a weirdo.

dialogues.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
dialogues.text: It's you again!?

dialogues.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
dialogues.text: Didn't I tell you to... Oh, forget it. Do as you like.

dialogues.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
dialogues.text: Just don't mess around with my things. There are just enough supplies on the ship for you. Leave as soon as you are satisfied.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like some help?

dialogues.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
dialogues.text: No. Can't you see that I'm doing just fine?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But your wound...

dialogues.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
dialogues.text: It's my wound, not yours.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, we asked out of kindness!

dialogues.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
dialogues.text: Then I also answer you out of kindness: don't bother me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I can help you.

dialogues.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
dialogues.text: How can you help me, hand me over to the shogunate?

dialogues.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
dialogues.text: Haha, I'd advise you against such misguided mercy... I will be treated as a deserter, and Lord Kujou has never shown mercy to deserters.

dialogues.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
dialogues.text: If you really want to help me, then give me some peace and quiet.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, this guy is so grumpy!

dialogues.speaker: Inaba Kyuuzou
dialogues.text: Stop bothering me. Find some other way to occupy yourself.
